description: The file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page 'ShowAns.aspx', responsible for displaying student answers and submitting marks in an online examination system. It interacts with a SQL database to fetch answer data based on session variables and allows an administrator to submit marks for different questions.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for the 'ShowAns.aspx' page handling the display of answers and submission of marks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load, fetches student answers from database for questions 1 to 5 based on session data and populates UI controls.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks from UI inputs, updates database with marks, removes student from course queue, and transfers to AdminCourseQueue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and transfers to LoginPage.
